title: Final project: Dashboard layout
instructions:
Final challenge: Assemble the entire application

Your task is to transform the broken HTML code into a modern dashboard. You will need to use everything you know about CSS Grid, Flexbox, and Position.

  • .app-container: The entire application runs in a wrapper. Use Flexbox on it so that the sidebar and main content sit nicely side by side. Ensure the application takes up the full height of the screen.
  • .sidebar: Set the width to 250px and use Flexbox to arrange the menu items in a column, pushing them apart so that the logout button goes all the way to the bottom.
  • .main-content: It occupies the remaining space. It has its own 30px padding.
  • .stats-grid: In the main content, there is a statistics grid. Set it up as a CSS Grid with 3 equal columns and a 20px gap.
  • .user-profile: In the header, there is a name and a notification. Use Flexbox on them so they are vertically aligned.
  • .badge: This is the hardest part. Change .notification to relative. Change the red bubble itself (.badge) to absolute in the top-right corner (-5px from the top and right). Do not forget to round the corners, add a background color, set the height and width to 18px, set the font size to 12px, and center it correctly.
